evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report page 9, principal business: data-center cooling and Coolinside full-chain liquid-cooling products
evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing places data-center and computing-equipment cooling inside the company's principal business and lists an end-to-end liquid-cooling portfolio including cold plates, quick connectors, manifolds, CDU, cabinets, coolant, piping, and cooling sources.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report pages 15-16, product revenue table
evidence_items.evidence_summary: Machine-room temperature-control products generated about RMB 3.448 billion, or 56.83% of company revenue. Liquid cooling is included in this broader product family but is not separately disclosed, so exact liquid-cooling revenue remains undisclosed.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report pages 11-13, AIDC power supply and UPS products
evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing describes mass-market modular UPS products, a 1.2MW UPS certification, deployed prefabricated power modules, and jointly developed UPS products for high-density data-center scenarios.
Data-center products generated about RMB 2.239 billion, or 27.44% of company revenue. The filing does not disclose UPS-only revenue inside that broader product category.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report pages 20-21, data-center power products and customers
evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing lists air-cooled and immersion-cooled CRPS power supplies, customized GPU power supplies, and centralized power systems, and reports shipments or cooperation with major server-system and cloud customers.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report pages 20 and 22-23, data-center power revenue
evidence_items.evidence_summary: Data-center power revenue was about RMB 2.015 billion, representing 45.17% of company revenue; high-power data-center power revenue was about RMB 1.299 billion within that segment.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report pages 11-12, AIDC key power and HVDC systems
evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing describes 240V, 336V, and 800V HVDC systems, states that the products have been scaled in cloud, intelligent-computing, and colocation data centers, and presents an end-to-end data-center power product matrix.

evidence_items.excerpt_locator: Annual report page 25, product revenue composition
evidence_items.evidence_summary: Data-center power revenue was about RMB 775.8 million, representing 36.30% of company revenue. The filing does not split HVDC-only revenue from the broader data-center power category.
